function parseDateFromText(text){let m=String(text).match(/\b(20\d{2})[-/.](0?[1-9]|1[0-2])[-/.](0?[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])\b/);if(m)return `${m[1]}-${m[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${m[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;m=String(text).match(/\b(0?[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])[-/.,](0?[1-9]|1[0-2])[-/.,](20\d{2}|\d{2})\b/);if(m){let y=m[3].length===2?'20'+m[3]:m[3];return `${y}-${m[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${m[1].padStart(2,'0')}`}return ''}

const MX_FILE_LIBS={
  xlsx:{id:'mx-lib-xlsx',url:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js',ready:()=>!!window.XLSX},
  pdf:{id:'mx-lib-pdfjs',url:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@3.11.174/build/pdf.min.js',ready:()=>!!window.pdfjsLib},
  docx:{id:'mx-lib-mammoth',url:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mammoth@1.12.0/mammoth.browser.min.js',ready:()=>!!window.mammoth}
};
const mxLibPromises={};
function mxLoadFileLib(kind,timeout=12000){
  const lib=MX_FILE_LIBS[kind];if(!lib||lib.ready())return Promise.resolve(true);if(mxLibPromises[kind])return mxLibPromises[kind];
  mxLibPromises[kind]=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let done=false,t=null;const finish=(ok,err)=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(t);if(ok&&lib.ready())resolve(true);else{delete mxLibPromises[kind];reject(err||new Error('No se pudo cargar el lector de archivos'))}};let sc=document.getElementById(lib.id);if(sc){if(lib.ready())return finish(true);sc.addEventListener('load',()=>finish(true),{once:true});sc.addEventListener('error',()=>finish(false,new Error('No se pudo cargar el lector de archivos. Verifica Internet.')),{once:true})}else{sc=document.createElement('script');sc.id=lib.id;sc.src=lib.url;sc.async=true;sc.crossOrigin='anonymous';sc.onload=()=>finish(true);sc.onerror=()=>finish(false,new Error('No se pudo cargar el lector de archivos. Verifica Internet.'));document.head.appendChild(sc)}t=setTimeout(()=>finish(false,new Error('El lector de archivos tardó demasiado en responder. Intenta nuevamente.')),timeout)});return mxLibPromises[kind]
}
async function mxEnsureFileLib(ext){if(['xlsx','xls'].includes(ext))return mxLoadFileLib('xlsx');if(ext==='pdf')return mxLoadFileLib('pdf');if(ext==='docx')return mxLoadFileLib('docx');return true}
async function parseFile(file,fileId){const ext=file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();await mxEnsureFileLib(ext);if(['xlsx','xls'].includes(ext))return parseXlsx(file,fileId);if(ext==='pdf')return parsePdf(file,fileId);if(ext==='docx')return parseDocx(file,fileId);if(['csv','txt'].includes(ext))return parseTextFile(file,fileId);throw new Error('Formato no compatible')}
async function parseXlsx(file,fileId){if(!window.XLSX)throw new Error('No se cargó el lector de Excel. Revisa la conexión a internet.');const ab=await file.arrayBuffer(),wb=XLSX.read(ab,{type:'array',cellDates:true});let out=[],date='',service='';for(const sh of wb.SheetNames){const ws=wb.Sheets[sh],matrix=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws,{header:1,defval:'',raw:false});const flat=matrix.slice(0,20).flat().join(' ');if(!date)date=parseDateFromText(flat);const sv=detectService(file.name,flat,sh);if(service==='')service=sv;out.push(...parseMatrix(matrix,{fileId,source:file.name,sheet:sh,service:sv,status:/EGRESO|DEFUNC/i.test(norm(sh))?'egreso':'active'}))}return{records:dedupeRecords(out),date,service}}
function parseMatrix(matrix,ctx){let out=[];if(!matrix.length)return out;const nrows=matrix.map(r=>r.map(x=>cleanSpaces(x)));let header=-1,map={};for(let i=0;i<Math.min(20,nrows.length);i++){const row=nrows[i].map(norm);let nameIdx=row.findIndex(x=>x.includes('NOMBRE'));if(nameIdx>=0){header=i;map.name=nameIdx;map.age=row.findIndex(x=>x==='EDAD'||x.includes('EDAD'));map.sex=row.findIndex(x=>x.includes('SEXO')||x.includes('GENERO'));map.nhc=row.findIndex(x=>x.includes('NHC')||x.includes('EXPED'));map.dx=row.findIndex(x=>x.includes('DIAGN'));map.bed=row.findIndex(x=>x.includes('CAMA'));break}}
 if(header>=0){for(let i=header+1;i<nrows.length;i++){const row=nrows[i];let raw=row[map.name]||'';if(!raw)continue;let name=cleanEmbeddedName(raw),age=map.age>=0?extractAge(row[map.age])||parseInt(row[map.age],10)||'':extractAge(raw),sex=map.sex>=0?extractSex(row[map.sex]):extractSex(raw),nhc=map.nhc>=0?cleanSpaces(row[map.nhc]):extractNhc(raw),dx=map.dx>=0?row[map.dx]:'',bed=map.bed>=0?row[map.bed]:'';if(map.bed>=0&&!bed)continue;if(!nhc)nhc=extractNhc(raw);if(!validName(name))continue;out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name,age:Number.isFinite(age)?age:'',sex,nhc,diagnosis:dx,bed,confidence:.92}))}return out}
 // Medicina Interna y hojas sin encabezado de nombre: cama | nombre | diagnóstico | fecha...
 for(let i=0;i<nrows.length;i++){const row=nrows[i];if(row.length<2)continue;let first=norm(row[0]),raw=row[1]||'';if((/^\d{2,4}[A-Z]?$/.test(first)||/^(?:UTI|UTAM|OBS|A-?\d|B-?\d)/.test(first))&&validName(cleanEmbeddedName(raw))){let name=cleanEmbeddedName(raw),age=extractAge(raw),nhc=extractNhc(raw),dx=row[2]||'',sex=extractSex(raw),bed=row[0];out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name,age,sex,nhc,diagnosis:dx,bed,confidence:.86}))}}
 // hoja EGRESOS puede traer fila sin encabezados
 if(/EGRESO|DEFUNC/i.test(norm(ctx.sheet))){for(let i=0;i<nrows.length;i++){const row=nrows[i];if(row.length>=2&&/^\d{2,4}$/.test(norm(row[0]))&&validName(cleanEmbeddedName(row[1]))){let raw=row[1];out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name:cleanEmbeddedName(raw),age:extractAge(raw),nhc:extractNhc(raw),diagnosis:row[2]||'',bed:row[0],status:'egreso',confidence:.88}))}}}
 return out}
async function parsePdf(file,fileId){if(!window.pdfjsLib)throw new Error('No se cargó el lector PDF. Revisa la conexión a internet.');pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@3.11.174/build/pdf.worker.min.js';const ab=await file.arrayBuffer(),pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:ab}).promise;let lines=[];for(let p=1;p<=pdf.numPages;p++){const page=await pdf.getPage(p),tc=await page.getTextContent({normalizeWhitespace:true}),items=tc.items.filter(i=>i.str&&i.str.trim()).map(i=>({text:cleanSpaces(i.str),x:i.transform[4],y:i.transform[5],w:i.width||0,h:i.height||0,page:p}));lines.push(...groupPdfItems(items,p))}const text=lines.map(x=>x.text).join('\n'),service=detectService(file.name,text),date=parseDateFromText(text);let out=[];const n=norm(text);if(n.includes('NEONATOLOG'))out=parsePdfNeonatal(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service});else if(n.includes('GINECOLOGIA')||n.includes('OBSTETRICIA'))out=parsePdfGyn(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service});else if(n.includes('VIGILANCIA EPIDEMIOLOGICA')||n.includes('AISLAMIENTO'))out=parsePdfIsolation(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service});else out=parsePdfGeneral(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service});if(out.length<2)out.push(...parsePdfGenericNames(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service}));return{records:dedupeRecords(out),date,service}}
function groupPdfItems(items,page){let groups=[];items.sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y||a.x-b.x);for(const it of items){let g=groups.find(g=>Math.abs(g.y-it.y)<=2.2);if(!g){g={y:it.y,page,items:[]};groups.push(g)}g.items.push(it)}groups.sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y);return groups.map(g=>{g.items.sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x);return{page:g.page,y:g.y,items:g.items,text:cleanSpaces(g.items.map(i=>i.text).join(' '))}})}
function parsePdfGeneral(lines,ctx){let out=[];for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){const s=lines[i].text;let m=s.match(/^(.*?)\b(\d{1,3})\s+(\d{4,9})\s+(\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{2,4})\b\s*(.*)$/);if(m){let name=cleanPrefixName(m[1]),age=+m[2],nhc=m[3],rest=m[5]||'',bed=extractLeadingBed(m[1]);if(!validName(name)||name.split(' ').length<=2||m[1].includes(','))name=findContextName(lines,i,name);let dx=extractDiagnosisFromRest(rest,'cg');if(!dx)dx=findNearbyDiagnosis(lines,i);if(validName(name))out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name,age,nhc,bed,diagnosis:dx,confidence:nameScore(name)>.8?.9:.7}));continue}
 m=s.match(/^([A-Z0-9-]{1,8})\s+(\d{4,9})\s*(.*?)\s+(\d{1,3})\s+(\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{2,4})\b\s*(.*)$/i);if(m){let bed=m[1],nhc=m[2],name=cleanEmbeddedName(m[3]),age=+m[4],rest=m[6]||'';if(!validName(name)||name.split(' ').length<=2||m[3].includes(','))name=findContextName(lines,i,name);let dx=extractDiagnosisFromRest(rest,'mod');if(!dx)dx=findNearbyDiagnosis(lines,i);if(validName(name))out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name,age,nhc,bed,diagnosis:dx,confidence:nameScore(name)>.8?.9:.68}))}}
 return out}
function extractLeadingBed(prefix){let t=norm(prefix).split(' ');return t.find(x=>/^\d{1,3}[A-Z]?$/.test(x)||/^(?:A-?\d+|B-?\d+|OBS\d+|UTI\d+)$/.test(x))||''}
function findContextName(lines,i,base=''){let parts=[];if(validName(base))parts.push(base);for(const j of [i-2,i-1,i+1]){if(j<0||j>=lines.length)continue;let c=leadingNameWords(lines[j].text);if(validName(c)&&nameScore(c)>.65)parts.push(c)}let combined=cleanSpaces(parts.join(' '));if(validName(combined)&&combined.split(' ').length<=8)return combined;return parts.sort((a,b)=>nameScore(b)-nameScore(a)||b.length-a.length)[0]||base}
function findNearbyDiagnosis(lines,i){for(const j of [i-2,i-1,i+1,i+2]){if(j<0||j>=lines.length)continue;let s=lines[j].text;if(s.length>18&&!validName(s)&&!/^\d/.test(s)&&!MED_STOP.test(s.slice(0,18))&&!/LAB|TP |TPT|INR|HB |HTO|PLAQ|SV:/i.test(s))return s.slice(0,320)}return ''}
function extractDiagnosisFromRest(rest,type){let s=cleanSpaces(rest);if(type==='cg')s=s.replace(/^\d{1,3}\s+/,'');else s=s.replace(/^\d{1,3}\s+(?:URG|MI|CG|UTAM|UTI|RECU|OBS\w*)?\s*/i,'');let cut=s.search(MED_STOP);if(cut>8)s=s.slice(0,cut);return s.length>6?s.slice(0,420):''}
function parsePdfNeonatal(lines,ctx){let out=[];for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){let s=lines[i].text;let m=s.match(/^([0-9]{2,3}[A-Z]?)\s+(.+?)\s+(\d{5,9}\/\d{2}|\d{5,9})\s+/i);if(!m)continue;let bed=m[1],name=cleanEmbeddedName(m[2]),nhc=m[3];if(lines[i+1]&&/^gemelo\s+\d+/i.test(lines[i+1].text))name=cleanSpaces(name+' '+lines[i+1].text.match(/^gemelo\s+\d+/i)[0]);if(!validName(name))continue;let sex='';for(const j of [i,i+1,i+2])if(lines[j])sex=sex||extractSex(lines[j].text);let dx=s.slice(m[0].length);let cut=dx.search(/\b(?:DELICADO|ESTABLE|CPAP|VENTILACION|O2|INDIRECTO)\b/i);if(cut>5)dx=dx.slice(0,cut);if(dx.length<8&&lines[i+1])dx=lines[i+1].text;out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,bed,name,nhc,sex,diagnosis:dx,confidence:.88}))}return out}
function parsePdfIsolation(lines,ctx){let out=[];for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){let s=lines[i].text;let m=s.match(/^(?:[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚÑ]+\s+)?([A-Z]?\d{1,3})\s+(\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{2,4})\s+(.+?)\s+(?:PANEL|HERPES|PB\.|CULTIVO|UROCULTIVO|HEMOCULTIVO|COPRO|ASPIRADO|SECRECION|SECRECIÓN)\b/i);if(m){let name=cleanEmbeddedName(m[3]);if(validName(name))out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,bed:m[1],name,confidence:.9}));continue}
 // Rows often begin with bed then date, followed by name; infer split before diagnostic terms
 m=s.match(/^([A-Z]?\d{1,3})\s+(\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{1,2}[\/,.\-]\d{2,4})\s+(.+)$/i);if(m){let tail=m[3],cut=tail.search(/\b(?:PANEL|HERPES|PB\.|CULT|CLOSTR|MENINGITIS)\b/i),name=cleanEmbeddedName(cut>0?tail.slice(0,cut):tail);if(validName(name))out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,bed:m[1],name,confidence:.82}))}}
 return out}
function parsePdfGyn(lines,ctx){let out=[];const nhcRows=[];for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)if(/\bNHC\s*:/i.test(lines[i].text))nhcRows.push(i);for(const i of nhcRows){let nhc=extractNhc(lines[i].text);if(!nhc)continue;let age='',ageIdx=-1;for(let j=Math.max(0,i-5);j<=Math.min(lines.length-1,i+1);j++){let a=extractAge(lines[j].text);if(a!==''){age=a;ageIdx=j;break}}let candidates=[];const start=Math.max(0,(ageIdx>=0?ageIdx:i)-4),end=(ageIdx>=0?ageIdx:i);for(let j=start;j<end;j++){let s=lines[j].text;if(/NHC|CAMA|FECHA|TURNO|HOSPITAL|RECUPERACION|RECUPERACIÓN|TERAPIA|HOSPITALIZACION|HOSPITALIZACIÓN/i.test(s))continue;let c=nameFragment(s);if(c)candidates.push(c)}let name='';if(candidates.length>=2){let a=candidates.slice(-2).join(' ');name=validName(a)&&a.split(' ').length<=7?a:candidates[candidates.length-1]}else name=candidates[0]||'';if(!validName(name))continue;let dx='';if(ageIdx>=0){let s=lines[ageIdx].text.replace(/\b\d{1,3}\s*AÑOS?\b/i,' ').replace(/\bDOMICILIO\b\s*\d*/i,' ').replace(/\bHMI\b\s*\d*/i,' ');let cut=s.search(MED_STOP);if(cut>10)s=s.slice(0,cut);dx=cleanSpaces(s)}let bed='';for(let j=i;j<=Math.min(lines.length-1,i+2);j++){let m=lines[j].text.match(/\bCAMA\s*:\s*([A-Z0-9-]+)/i);if(m){bed=m[1];break}}out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name,age,nhc,bed,diagnosis:dx,confidence:.78}))}return out}
function parsePdfGenericNames(lines,ctx){let out=[];for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++){let s=lines[i].text;if(s.length<5||s.length>80)continue;let c=leadingNameWords(s);if(validName(c)&&nameScore(c)>.86){let around=(lines[i+1]?.text||'')+' '+(lines[i+2]?.text||'');if(/NHC|EDAD|AÑOS|\d{4,9}/i.test(around))out.push(makeRecord({...ctx,name:c,age:extractAge(around),nhc:extractNhc(around),confidence:.58}))}}return out}
async function parseDocx(file,fileId){if(!window.mammoth)throw new Error('No se cargó el lector de Word. Revisa la conexión a internet.');const ab=await file.arrayBuffer(),r=await mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer:ab}),text=r.value||'',lines=text.split(/\r?\n/).map(cleanSpaces).filter(Boolean),service=detectService(file.name,text),date=parseDateFromText(text);return{records:dedupeRecords(parsePlainLines(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service})),date,service}}
async function parseTextFile(file,fileId){const text=await file.text(),lines=text.split(/\r?\n/).map(cleanSpaces).filter(Boolean),service=detectService(file.name,text),date=parseDateFromText(text);let records;if(file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')){const matrix=lines.map(l=>splitCsv(l));records=parseMatrix(matrix,{fileId,source:file.name,service,status:'active'})}else records=parsePlainLines(lines,{fileId,source:file.name,service});return{records:dedupeRecords(records),date,service}}
function splitCsv(line){let a=[],cur='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){let c=line[i];if(c==='"'){if(q&&line[i+1]==='"'){cur+='"';i++}else q=!q}else if((c===','||c===';')&&!q){a.push(cur);cur=''}else cur+=c}a.push(cur);return a}
function parsePlainLines(lines,ctx){let fake=lines.map((text,i)=>({text,y:lines.length-i,page:1,items:[]}));let out=parsePdfGeneral(fake,ctx);if(out.length<2)out.push(...parsePdfGenericNames(fake,ctx));return out}
function dedupeRecords(arr){const m=new Map();for(const r of arr){if(!validName(r.name))continue;let k=(r.nhc?norm(r.nhc):'')+'|'+norm(r.name)+'|'+norm(r.service);let old=m.get(k);if(!old||r.confidence>old.confidence)m.set(k,r)}return [...m.values()]}



function getCfg(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CFG_KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch(_e){return{}}}
function saveCfg(x){const n={...getCfg(),...x};try{localStorage.setItem(CFG_KEY,JSON.stringify(n))}catch(_e){}return n}
window.mxViewerGetCfg=getCfg;window.mxViewerSaveCfg=(x)=>saveCfg(x);window.mxViewerUnitName=()=>getCfg().unitName||'';
function deviceId(){try{return window.mxUnifiedActivation?.deviceId?.()||localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_KEY)||('CENSO-'+uid())}catch(_e){return localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_KEY)||('CENSO-'+uid())}}
function cleanDb(v){return String(v||'').trim().replace(/\.json\/?$/i,'').replace(/\/+$/,'')}
function dbUrl(path){const db=cleanDb(getCfg().db);if(!db)throw new Error('Esperando conexión con Sistema Principal');const p=String(path||'').startsWith('/')?String(path):'/'+String(path||'');return db+p+(p.endsWith('.json')?'':'.json')}
async function mxFetchTimeout(url,init={},timeout=7000){const c=new AbortController(),t=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),timeout);try{return await fetch(url,{...init,signal:c.signal})}finally{clearTimeout(t)}}
async function fbGet(path){const r=await mxFetchTimeout(dbUrl(path)+'?ts='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'},7000);if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Firebase HTTP '+r.status);return r.json().catch(()=>null)}
function mxCensoSyncKey(path){const p=String(path||'');if(p.includes('/viewer_licenses/'))return'activations';if(p.includes('/hospital_census/')||p.includes('/patient_catalog/'))return'patients';return''}
async function mxCensoBump(path){const key=mxCensoSyncKey(path);if(!key||String(path||'').includes('/sync_versions/'))return;try{const v=Math.max(Date.now(),Number(localStorage.getItem('mx_censo_sync_'+key)||0)+1);localStorage.setItem('mx_censo_sync_'+key,String(v));await mxFetchTimeout(dbUrl(`/sync_versions/${safePath(branch())}/${key}`),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({v,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),source:'CENSO_HOSPITALARIO'}),cache:'no-store'},5000)}catch(_e){}}
async function fbPut(path,data){const r=await mxFetchTimeout(dbUrl(path),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data),cache:'no-store'},9000);if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Firebase HTTP '+r.status);const out=await r.json().catch(()=>null);await mxCensoBump(path);return out}
async function fbPatch(path,data){const r=await mxFetchTimeout(dbUrl(path),{method:'PATCH',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data),cache:'no-store'},9000);if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Firebase HTTP '+r.status);const out=await r.json().catch(()=>null);await mxCensoBump(path);return out}
function controlUrl(path){const p=String(path||'').startsWith('/')?String(path):'/'+String(path||'');return CONTROL_DB+p+(p.endsWith('.json')?'':'.json')}
async function cget(path){try{const r=await mxFetchTimeout(controlUrl(path)+'?ts='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'},5500);if(!r.ok)return null;return r.json().catch(()=>null)}catch(_e){return null}}
async function cpatch(path,data){try{const r=await mxFetchTimeout(controlUrl(path),{method:'PATCH',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data||{}),cache:'no-store'},5500);return r.ok}catch(_e){return false}}
function routeSignature(raw=''){try{const u=new URL(raw||location.href);let p=(u.pathname||'/').replace(/\/index\.html?$/i,'/').replace(/\/+$/,'')+'/';return u.origin.toLowerCase()+p}catch(_e){return''}}
function baseSignature(){try{return new URL(location.href).origin.toLowerCase()}catch(_e){return''}}
async function sha256(s){try{const b=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(String(s||'')));return Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}catch(_e){return hashSync(s)}}
function hashSync(s){let h=2166136261;for(const c of String(s||'')){h^=c.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return(h>>>0).toString(36)}
function mxQuerySystemId(){try{const u=new URL(location.href),id=String(u.searchParams.get('mxSystem')||u.searchParams.get('mxPrincipal')||u.searchParams.get('mxSystemId')||'').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[.#$\[\]\/]/g,'_');return /^MACROXEL-[A-Z0-9_-]{4,}$/.test(id)?id:''}catch(_e){return''}}
async function bindEcosystem(force=false){if(bindingBusy&&!force)return bindingBusy;bindingBusy=(async()=>{const [routeHash,baseHash]=await Promise.all([sha256(routeSignature()),sha256(baseSignature())]);const [routeRec,baseRec]=await Promise.all([cget('/ecosystem_connection/route_bindings/'+encodeURIComponent(routeHash)),cget('/ecosystem_connection/github_bases/'+encodeURIComponent(baseHash))]);const routeOk=routeRec&&String(routeRec.appCode||'').toUpperCase()===APP_CODE?routeRec:null;const routeId=String(routeOk?.systemId||routeOk?.unitId||routeOk?.branch||'').trim().toUpperCase(),baseId=String(baseRec?.systemId||baseRec?.unitId||baseRec?.branch||'').trim().toUpperCase(),queryId=mxQuerySystemId();if(routeId&&baseId&&routeId!==baseId)throw new Error('La ruta GitHub está asociada a otro Sistema Principal');let sid=routeId||baseId||queryId;if(queryId&&sid&&queryId!==sid)throw new Error('El visor no corresponde al Sistema Principal que lo abrió');if(!sid)throw new Error('Ruta GitHub aún no asociada al Sistema Principal. Pulsa “Verificar visores” en Configuración.');const rec=await cget('/ecosystem_connection/'+encodeURIComponent(sid));const db=cleanDb(rec?.firebaseUrl||rec?.db||rec?.currentUrl||rec?.url);if(!db)throw new Error('El Sistema Principal no tiene una Firebase ACTIVA publicada');saveCfg({branch:sid,db,unitName:String(rec?.unitName||rec?.unidad||'')});setConnection(true,'Conectado · '+(rec?.unitName||sid));await heartbeat(true);return getCfg()})().catch(e=>{setConnection(false,e.message||'Sin conexión');throw e}).finally(()=>bindingBusy=null);return bindingBusy}
function setConnection(ok,msg){$('#connDot').className='status-dot '+(ok?'ok':'bad');$('#connText').textContent=msg|| (ok?'Conectado':'Sin conexión')}
async function heartbeat(force=false){const cfg=getCfg(),sid=String(cfg.branch||'').trim().toUpperCase();if(!sid)return;const key=await sha256(deviceId()+'|'+APP_CODE+'|'+sid),ctl=await cget('/ecosystem_connection/device_control/'+encodeURIComponent(key)).catch(()=>null);maintenancePaused=ctl?.paused===true;const routeHash=await sha256(cleanDb(cfg.db));await cpatch('/inventory_heartbeat/visor_presence/'+encodeURIComponent(key),{appCode:APP_CODE,branch:sid,unitName:cfg.unitName||'',deviceType:/android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)?'Android':/iphone|ipad/i.test(navigator.userAgent)?'iOS':'Web',lastSeenAt:new Date().toISOString(),lastSeenMs:Date.now(),routeHash,routeMode:'PRODUCTION',viewerVersion:VERSION,connectionPaused:maintenancePaused,maintenanceReason:ctl?.reason||'',controlVersion:VERSION}).catch(()=>{});if(maintenancePaused){setConnection(false,'Pausado por Administrador');$('#btnValidateDelivery').disabled=true}}
function branch(){return String(getCfg().branch||'').trim().toUpperCase()}
function safePath(v){return encodeURIComponent(String(v||'').replace(/[.#$\[\]\/]/g,'_'))}

function licensePath(id=deviceId()){return `/viewer_licenses/${safePath(branch())}/${safePath(id)}`}
function licenseCacheGet(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LICENSE_CACHE_KEY)||'null')}catch(_e){return null}}
function licenseCacheSet(v){try{localStorage.setItem(LICENSE_CACHE_KEY,JSON.stringify(v||null))}catch(_e){}}
function activationPerson(rec={}){return window.mxUnifiedActivation?.cleanPerson?.(rec)||{fullName:cleanSpaces(rec.fullName||rec.nombre||rec.name),phone:cleanSpaces(rec.phone||rec.telefono),email:cleanSpaces(rec.email||rec.correo)}}
function showGate(message,kind=''){const gate=$('#activationGate'),msg=$('#activationMsg');if(gate)gate.classList.remove('hide');if(msg){msg.className='gate-msg'+(kind?' '+kind:'');msg.textContent=message||'Validando activación…'}}
function hideGate(){const gate=$('#activationGate');if(gate)gate.classList.add('hide')}
const MX_CENSO_SPLASH_AT=Date.now();function hideSplash(){const el=$('#mxStartupSplash');if(!el)return;const wait=Math.max(0,2900-(Date.now()-MX_CENSO_SPLASH_AT));setTimeout(()=>{const x=$('#mxStartupSplash');if(!x)return;x.classList.add('hide');setTimeout(()=>x.remove(),300)},wait)}
function fillActivationInputs(rec={}){const p=activationPerson(rec);if($('#actName')&&!$('#actName').value)$('#actName').value=p.fullName||'';if($('#actPhone')&&!$('#actPhone').value)$('#actPhone').value=p.phone||'';if($('#actEmail')&&!$('#actEmail').value)$('#actEmail').value=p.email||''}
function applyActivatedUser(rec={}){activatedUser=activationPerson(rec);fillActivationInputs(rec);renderDeliveryState()}
function deliveryOperator(){const p=activatedUser||activationPerson(licenseCacheGet()||{});return cleanSpaces(p?.fullName)||'Dispositivo Macroxel'}
async function readLicense(id=deviceId()){return fbGet(licensePath(id)).catch(()=>null)}
async function writeLicense(data,id=deviceId()){return fbPut(licensePath(id),data)}
function licenseMessage(state){return state==='pending'?'Solicitud enviada. Está pendiente de activación en Administrador.':state==='expired'?'La licencia de este dispositivo está vencida. Solicita renovación.':state==='suspended'?'El acceso de este dispositivo está suspendido.':'Este dispositivo todavía no tiene activado Censo Hospitalario.'}
async function validateLicense(show=true){
  const cached=licenseCacheGet(),cachedState=window.mxUnifiedActivation?.appState?.(cached,APP_CODE)||'missing',cachedActive=cachedState==='active';
  try{
    await bindEcosystem();
    let rec=await readLicense(deviceId());
    if(!rec){
      if(cachedActive||licensed){licensed=true;applyActivatedUser(cached||{});hideGate();clearTimeout(MX_BOOT_WATCHDOG);setConnection(false,'Licencia local vigente · registro remoto no disponible');return true}
      licensed=false;if(show)showGate('Este dispositivo todavía no tiene activado Censo Hospitalario.');return false;
    }
    if(window.mxUnifiedActivation?.adoptLegacy){rec=await window.mxUnifiedActivation.adoptLegacy(rec,{appCode:APP_CODE,appName:'MACROXEL Censo Hospitalario',version:VERSION,branch:branch(),unitName:getCfg().unitName||'',read:async id=>readLicense(id),write:async data=>writeLicense(data)}).catch(()=>rec)}
    const st=window.mxUnifiedActivation?.appState?.(rec,APP_CODE)||'missing';
    fillActivationInputs(rec||{});
    if(st==='active'){
      licensed=true;licenseCacheSet(rec);applyActivatedUser(rec||{});hideGate();clearTimeout(MX_BOOT_WATCHDOG);if(window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe){clearTimeout(window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe);window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe=null}setConnection(true,'Conectado · '+(getCfg().unitName||branch()));
      try{const patch=window.mxUnifiedActivation?.touchPatch?.(rec,APP_CODE,VERSION);if(patch)await fbPatch(licensePath(deviceId()),patch)}catch(_e){}
      return true;
    }
    if(st==='suspended'||st==='expired'){
      licensed=false;if(show)showGate(licenseMessage(st),'bad');return false;
    }
    if(cachedActive||licensed){
      licensed=true;applyActivatedUser(cached||rec||{});hideGate();clearTimeout(MX_BOOT_WATCHDOG);setConnection(false,'Acceso vigente · sincronización de licencia pendiente');return true;
    }
    licensed=false;if(show)showGate(licenseMessage(st));return false;
  }catch(e){
    if(cachedActive||licensed){licensed=true;applyActivatedUser(cached||{});hideGate();clearTimeout(MX_BOOT_WATCHDOG);if(window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe){clearTimeout(window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe);window.__mxCensoStartupFailSafe=null}setConnection(false,'Modo sin conexión · licencia local vigente');return true}
    licensed=false;if(show)showGate(e?.message||'No se pudo validar la activación.','bad');return false;
  }
}
async function submitActivation(){
  const name=cleanSpaces($('#actName')?.value),phone=cleanSpaces($('#actPhone')?.value),email=cleanSpaces($('#actEmail')?.value).toLowerCase();
  if(name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length<2)return showGate('Captura nombre completo y apellidos.','bad');
  if(phone.replace(/\D/g,'').length<7)return showGate('Captura un teléfono válido.','bad');
  if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email))return showGate('Captura un correo electrónico válido.','bad');
  const btn=$('#actSubmit');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Enviando…'}
  try{
    await bindEcosystem();
    const current=await readLicense(deviceId());
    const req=window.mxUnifiedActivation.prepareRequest(current,{appCode:APP_CODE,appName:'MACROXEL Censo Hospitalario',version:VERSION,branch:branch(),unitName:getCfg().unitName||'',person:{fullName:name,phone,email}});
    await writeLicense(req);fillActivationInputs(req);showGate('Solicitud enviada correctamente. Cuando Administrador la active, pulsa “Acceder”.','ok');
  }catch(e){showGate(e?.message||'No se pudo enviar la solicitud.','bad')}
  finally{if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Enviar solicitud'}}
}
async function initAccess(){
  showGate('Validando licencia y conexión con el Sistema Principal…');
  try{await bindEcosystem()}catch(e){showGate(e?.message||'No se pudo asociar este visor al Sistema Principal.','bad');hideSplash();return false}
  const ok=await validateLicense(true);hideSplash();if(ok)await refreshRemote();return ok;
}
function remotePatientKey(name){return'p_'+hashSync('N:'+norm(name))}
function remoteServiceKey(service){return's_'+hashSync(norm(service))}
function patientForFirebase(p){return{key:remotePatientKey(p.name),nombre:p.name,expediente:p.nhc||'',edad:p.age===''?'':p.age,sexo:p.sex||'',genero:p.sex||'',diagnostico:p.diagnosis||'',numeroCama:(p.beds||[])[0]||'',cama:(p.beds||[])[0]||'',servicios:p.services||[],servicio:(p.services||[])[0]||'',ultimoServicio:(p.services||[])[0]||'',fuentes:p.sources||[],confidence:p.confidence||0,censusDate:state.censusDate}}
function censusTokenSimilarity(a,b){const A=new Set(norm(a).split(' ').filter(x=>x.length>1)),B=new Set(norm(b).split(' ').filter(x=>x.length>1));if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;return[...A].filter(x=>B.has(x)).length/Math.max(A.size,B.size)}
function censusMatchOrder(o,activePatients){const rows=Object.values(activePatients||{}),exp=norm(o?.expediente||o?.numeroExpediente||''),name=cleanSpaces(o?.paciente||o?.nombrePaciente||'');let p=null;if(exp)p=rows.find(x=>norm(x.expediente)===exp);if(!p&&name)p=rows.find(x=>norm(x.nombre)===norm(name));if(!p&&name){let best=null,score=0;for(const x of rows){const z=censusTokenSimilarity(name,x.nombre);if(z>score){score=z;best=x}}if(best&&score>=.9)p=best}return p}
function isJustifiedOrder(o){return norm(o?.tipo||o?.tipo_doc||o?.tipoDocumento||'').includes('JUSTIFICADO')}
async function reconcileJustifiedOrders(activePatients,now,submissionId){const br=safePath(branch()),orders=await fbGet(`/service_orders/${br}`).catch(()=>null);let checked=0,inCensus=0,outCensus=0,filled=0;const jobs=[];for(const [id,o] of Object.entries(orders||{})){if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||!isJustifiedOrder(o))continue;checked++;const p=censusMatchOrder(o,activePatients),estado=p?'EN_CENSO':'NO_EN_CENSO',patch={censoHospitalarioEstado:estado,censoHospitalarioAlerta:!p,censoHospitalarioRevisadoAt:now,censoHospitalarioSubmissionId:submissionId,censoHospitalarioFuente:'CENSO_HOSPITALARIO',censoHospitalario:p?{estado,nombre:p.nombre||'',expediente:p.expediente||'',edad:p.edad??'',sexo:p.sexo||p.genero||'',diagnostico:p.diagnostico||'',numeroCama:p.numeroCama||p.cama||'',servicio:p.ultimoServicio||p.servicio||'',censusDate:p.censusDate||state.censusDate}: {estado,censusDate:state.censusDate}};if(p){inCensus++;let changed=false;if(!cleanSpaces(o.expediente)&&p.expediente){patch.expediente=p.expediente;changed=true}if((o.edad==null||o.edad==='')&&p.edad!==''){patch.edad=p.edad;changed=true}if(!cleanSpaces(o.genero||o.sexo)&&cleanSpaces(p.sexo||p.genero)){patch.genero=p.sexo||p.genero;patch.sexo=p.sexo||p.genero;changed=true}if(!cleanSpaces(o.diagnostico)&&p.diagnostico){patch.diagnostico=p.diagnostico;changed=true}if(!cleanSpaces(o.numeroCama||o.cama)&&cleanSpaces(p.numeroCama||p.cama)){patch.numeroCama=p.numeroCama||p.cama;changed=true}if(changed)filled++}else outCensus++;jobs.push(fbPatch(`/service_orders/${br}/${safePath(id)}`,patch))}for(let i=0;i<jobs.length;i+=20)await Promise.allSettled(jobs.slice(i,i+20));return{checked,inCensus,outCensus,filled}}

function addFiles(files){const supported=/\.(pdf|xlsx|xls|docx|csv|txt)$/i,remaining=Math.max(0,10-state.files.length);if(!remaining){toast('Máximo 10 archivos por entrega');return}const accepted=files.filter(f=>supported.test(f.name)).slice(0,remaining);if(files.length>remaining)toast('Solo se agregaron '+remaining+' archivo(s): el máximo es 10');for(const file of accepted){const id=uid();state.files.push({id,name:file.name,size:file.size,service:'Detectando...',status:'queued',count:0,error:'',progress:0});renderFiles();processOne(file,id)}save()}
async function processOne(file,id){const f=state.files.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!f)return;try{f.status='processing';f.progress=20;renderFiles();const r=await parseFile(file,id);f.progress=75;f.service=r.service||'Servicio por confirmar';f.count=r.records.length;f.status='done';f.progress=100;state.records=state.records.filter(x=>x.fileId!==id).concat(r.records);if(r.date&&!state.files.some(x=>x.id!==id&&x.status==='done'))state.censusDate=r.date;save();renderAll();toast(`${file.name}: ${r.records.length} pacientes extraídos`);if(state.files.length&&state.files.every(x=>x.status==='done'&&x.count>0))setTimeout(()=>activateTab('previa'),80)}catch(e){f.status='error';f.error=e.message||String(e);f.progress=100;save();renderAll();toast('No se pudo procesar '+file.name)}}
function serviceOptions(current){const opts=['Servicio por confirmar','Medicina Interna','Cirugía General','Ginecología y Obstetricia','Neonatología','Inhaloterapia','Aislamientos / Epidemiología','UTAM / Módulo A y B','Urgencias','Terapia Intensiva','Ortopedia / Traumatología','Pediatría','Recuperación'];return opts.filter(x=>x!==current).map(x=>`<option>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('')}
function renderFiles(){const box=$('#fileList');box.innerHTML='';for(const f of state.files){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='file';el.innerHTML=`<div><div class="fname">${esc(f.name)}</div><div class="fmeta">${fmtSize(f.size)} · ${f.status==='done'?`${f.count} pacientes detectados`:f.status==='processing'?'Procesando…':f.status==='error'?esc(f.error):'En cola'}</div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${f.progress||0}%"></i></div></div><select class="field fileService" data-id="${f.id}" ${f.status!=='done'?'disabled':''}><option>${esc(f.service||'Servicio por confirmar')}</option>${serviceOptions(f.service)}</select><button class="btn sm bad fileDelete" data-id="${f.id}">Quitar</button>`;box.appendChild(el)}$$('.fileDelete').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>removeFile(b.dataset.id));$$('.fileService').forEach(s=>s.onchange=()=>changeFileService(s.dataset.id,s.value));renderDeliveryState()}
function removeFile(id){state.files=state.files.filter(x=>x.id!==id);state.records=state.records.filter(x=>x.fileId!==id);save();renderAll()}
function changeFileService(id,service){const f=state.files.find(x=>x.id===id);if(f)f.service=service;state.records.filter(x=>x.fileId===id).forEach(r=>r.service=service);save();renderAll()}
function renderPatients(){const p=getMergedPatients(),q=norm($('#patientSearch').value),sv=$('#serviceFilter').value,rf=$('#reviewFilter').value;const services=[...new Set(p.flatMap(x=>x.services))].sort();const sel=$('#serviceFilter'),cur=sel.value;sel.innerHTML='<option value="">Todos los servicios</option>'+services.map(x=>`<option ${x===cur?'selected':''}>${esc(x)}</option>`).join('');let rows=p.filter(x=>(!q||norm([x.name,x.nhc,x.diagnosis,...x.services].join(' ')).includes(q))&&(!sv||x.services.includes(sv))&&(!rf||(rf==='review'?x.confidence<.68:x.confidence>=.68)));{const pc=$('#patientCount');if(pc)pc.textContent=rows.length+' mostrados';}$('#patientBody').innerHTML=rows.map(x=>`<tr><td><div class="name">${esc(x.name)}</div>${x.confidence<.68?'<span class="preview-badge review">REVISAR</span>':'<span class="preview-badge active">DETECTADO</span>'}</td><td>${esc(x.age)}</td><td>${esc(x.sex||'—')}</td><td>${esc(x.nhc||'—')}</td><td>${esc(x.beds.join(', ')||'—')}</td><td><div class="tags">${x.services.map(s=>`<span class="tag">${esc(s)}</span>`).join('')}</div></td><td class="diag">${esc(x.diagnosis||'—')}</td><td>${x.sources.map(s=>`<div class="mini">${esc(s)}</div>`).join('')}</td></tr>`).join('');$('#patientEmpty').classList.toggle('hide',rows.length>0)}
function openPatientModal(id){editPatientId=id||null;let p=id?getMergedPatients().find(x=>x.id===id):null;$('#modalTitle').textContent=p?'Editar paciente':'Agregar paciente';$('#mName').value=p?.name||'';$('#mAge').value=p?.age??'';$('#mSex').value=p?.sex||'';$('#mNhc').value=p?.nhc||'';$('#mBed').value=p?.beds?.[0]||'';$('#mService').value=p?.services?.[0]||state.files[0]?.service||'';$('#mDiagnosis').value=p?.diagnosis||'';$('#modalBack').classList.remove('hide')}
function savePatientModal(){const o={name:$('#mName').value,age:$('#mAge').value?+$('#mAge').value:'',sex:$('#mSex').value,nhc:$('#mNhc').value,bed:$('#mBed').value,service:$('#mService').value||'Servicio por confirmar',diagnosis:$('#mDiagnosis').value,confidence:1,source:'Corrección manual'};if(!validName(o.name)){toast('Revisa el nombre completo');return}if(editPatientId){const p=getMergedPatients().find(x=>x.id===editPatientId);if(p)p.records.forEach(r=>r.status='superseded')}state.manual.push(makeRecord(o));save();$('#modalBack').classList.add('hide');renderAll();toast('Corrección guardada')}
function renderDeliveryState(){const p=getMergedPatients(),done=state.files.length>0&&state.files.every(f=>f.status==='done'&&f.count>0),servicesOk=state.files.every(f=>f.service&&f.service!=='Servicio por confirmar'),ready=done&&servicesOk&&p.length>0&&!maintenancePaused;for(const id of ['btnValidateDelivery','btnGoDeliver']){const b=$('#'+id);if(b)b.disabled=!ready}const ds=$('#deliveryState');if(ds){ds.className=ready?'delivery-ready':'delivery-pending';ds.textContent=ready?`${p.length} pacientes listos`:state.files.some(f=>f.status==='processing')?'Procesando…':state.files.some(f=>f.status==='error')?'Revisa archivo con error':!servicesOk&&state.files.length?'Confirma servicio':'Selecciona un archivo'}const pr=$('#previewReadyText');if(pr)pr.textContent=ready?'Listo para validar':!servicesOk?'Confirma el servicio del archivo':'Revisa antes de entregar'}
function renderStats(){const p=getMergedPatients(),services=new Set(p.flatMap(x=>x.services));$('#stPatients').textContent=p.length;$('#stServices').textContent=services.size;$('#stFiles').textContent=state.files.length+'/10';$('#stReview').textContent=p.filter(x=>x.confidence<.68).length;$('#stRemote').textContent=remoteState.activeCount??'—';renderDeliveryState()}
function renderAll(){state.censusDate=state.censusDate||localISODate();$('#censusDate').value=state.censusDate;renderFiles();renderPatients();renderStats()}
function newDelivery(){if((state.files.length||getMergedPatients().length)&&!confirm('¿Corregir la carga? function mergeSnapshotPatients(snapshots){const map=new Map();for(const snap of Object.values(snapshots||{})){if(!snap||typeof snap!=='object')continue;for(const p of Object.values(snap.patients||{})){if(!p?.nombre)continue;const key=p.key||remotePatientKey(p.nombre),old=map.get(key)||{...p,servicios:[],fuentes:[]};old.nombre=p.nombre||old.nombre;old.expediente=p.expediente||old.expediente;old.edad=p.edad!==''&&p.edad!=null?p.edad:old.edad;old.sexo=p.sexo||old.sexo;old.genero=p.genero||old.genero;old.diagnostico=(p.diagnostico||'').length>(old.diagnostico||'').length?p.diagnostico:old.diagnostico;old.numeroCama=p.numeroCama||old.numeroCama;old.servicios=[...new Set([...(old.servicios||[]),...(p.servicios||[]),p.servicio].filter(Boolean))];old.servicio=old.servicios[0]||p.servicio||'';old.ultimoServicio=p.ultimoServicio||p.servicio||old.ultimoServicio;old.fuentes=[...new Set([...(old.fuentes||[]),...(p.fuentes||[])])];old.censusDate=p.censusDate||snap.censusDate||old.censusDate;old.lastSeenAt=snap.deliveredAt||p.lastSeenAt||old.lastSeenAt;old.internado=true;old.censusStatus='INTERNADO';old.key=key;map.set(key,old)}}return Object.fromEntries(map)}
function mergeSameDayPatient(old,p,now){old=old&&typeof old==='object'?old:{};p=p&&typeof p==='object'?p:{};const oldDiag=cleanSpaces(old.diagnostico),newDiag=cleanSpaces(p.diagnostico),servicios=[...new Set([...(old.servicios||[]),...(p.servicios||[]),old.servicio,p.servicio,old.ultimoServicio,p.ultimoServicio].map(cleanSpaces).filter(Boolean))],fuentes=[...new Set([...(old.fuentes||[]),...(p.fuentes||[])].map(cleanSpaces).filter(Boolean))];return{...old,...p,nombre:p.nombre||old.nombre||'',expediente:p.expediente||old.expediente||'',edad:(p.edad!==''&&p.edad!=null)?p.edad:(old.edad??''),sexo:p.sexo||p.genero||old.sexo||old.genero||'',genero:p.genero||p.sexo||old.genero||old.sexo||'',diagnostico:newDiag.length>=oldDiag.length?(newDiag||oldDiag):oldDiag,numeroCama:p.numeroCama||p.cama||old.numeroCama||old.cama||'',servicios,servicio:p.servicio||p.ultimoServicio||old.servicio||old.ultimoServicio||servicios[0]||'',ultimoServicio:p.ultimoServicio||p.servicio||old.ultimoServicio||old.servicio||servicios[0]||'',fuentes,censusDate:state.censusDate,lastSeenAt:now,internado:true,censusStatus:'INTERNADO',key:p.key||old.key||remotePatientKey(p.nombre||old.nombre||'')}}
function mergeSameDaySnapshot(oldSnap,g,now,responsible,submissionId){const oldPatients=oldSnap&&oldSnap.censusDate===state.censusDate&&oldSnap.patients&&typeof oldSnap.patients==='object'?oldSnap.patients:{},patients={...oldPatients};for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(g.patients||{}))patients[k]=mergeSameDayPatient(oldPatients[k],p,now);const files=[...new Set([...(Array.isArray(oldSnap?.files)?oldSnap.files:[]),...(g.files||[])].filter(Boolean))];return{serviceKey:remoteServiceKey(g.service),service:g.service,censusDate:state.censusDate,deliveredAt:now,deliveredBy:responsible,submissionId,files,patientCount:Object.keys(patients).length,patients,updateMode:Object.keys(oldPatients).length?'SUPPLEMENTAL':'DAILY'}}
function clearValidatedLocalDraft(){state.files=[];state.records=[];state.manual=[];state.censusDate=localISODate();save()}
async function deliver(){
  if(!licensed){showGate('Valida la activación antes de entregar información al ecosistema.','bad');return}
  const responsible=deliveryOperator(),patients=getMergedPatients();
  if(!patients.length)return toast('No hay pacientes para entregar');
  if(state.files.length<1||state.files.length>10)return toast('La entrega requiere de 1 a 10 archivos');
  if(state.files.some(f=>f.status!=='done'||!f.count))return toast('Espera a que todos los archivos terminen de procesarse');
  if(state.files.some(f=>!f.service||f.service==='Servicio por confirmar'))return toast('Confirma el servicio de cada archivo');
  if(maintenancePaused)return toast('La conexión está pausada por Administrador');
  try{await bindEcosystem()}catch(e){return toast(e.message)}
  const summary=state.files.map(f=>`${f.service}: ${f.count}`).join('\n');
  if(!confirm(`¿Validar y entregar este censo a MACROXEL?\n\nFecha: ${state.censusDate}\nPacientes de esta carga: ${patients.length}\n\n${summary}\n\nSi ya existe un censo de esta misma fecha, esta entrega se agregará como actualización complementaria sin borrar a los pacientes enviados previamente.\n\nFarmacovigilancia y el Sistema Principal usarán el censo consolidado para identificar pacientes internados.`))return;
  const btn=$('#btnValidateDelivery'),btnVisible=$('#btnGoDeliver');for(const b of [btn,btnVisible])if(b){b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Entregando…'}
  try{
    const br=branch(),now=new Date().toISOString(),submissionId='CENSO_'+Date.now()+'_'+hashSync(responsible).slice(0,6),base=`/hospital_census/${safePath(br)}`,
      previous=await fbGet(base+'/active').catch(()=>null)||{},previousDate=cleanSpaces(previous?.meta?.censusDate||''),isSameDay=previousDate===state.censusDate&&!!previousDate,
      deliveryType=isSameDay?'ACTUALIZACION_DIA':'CENSO_DIARIO',groups={};

    // Una fecha nueva inicia un ciclo diario limpio. Entregas posteriores de esa misma fecha son complementarias.
    if(!isSameDay)await fbPut(base+'/service_snapshots',{});

    for(const f of state.files){
      const service=f.service,sk=remoteServiceKey(service);groups[sk]=groups[sk]||{service,files:[],patients:{}};groups[sk].files.push(f.name);
      for(const p of patients){if(!p.services.includes(service))continue;const rp=patientForFirebase(p);groups[sk].patients[rp.key]=rp}
    }

    for(const [sk,g] of Object.entries(groups)){
      if(!Object.keys(g.patients).length)throw new Error('El servicio '+g.service+' no tiene pacientes detectados.');
      const oldSnap=isSameDay?await fbGet(`${base}/service_snapshots/${sk}`).catch(()=>null):null;
      const snap=isSameDay?mergeSameDaySnapshot(oldSnap,g,now,responsible,submissionId):{serviceKey:sk,service:g.service,censusDate:state.censusDate,deliveredAt:now,deliveredBy:responsible,submissionId,files:g.files,patientCount:Object.keys(g.patients).length,patients:g.patients,updateMode:'DAILY'};
      await fbPut(`${base}/service_snapshots/${sk}`,snap);
    }

    const snapshots=await fbGet(base+'/service_snapshots')||{},snapActive=mergeSnapshotPatients(snapshots),oldPatients=previous?.patients||{};
    // En una actualización del mismo día jamás se da de alta por simple omisión de una carga complementaria.
    const activePatients=isSameDay?Object.fromEntries([...new Set([...Object.keys(oldPatients),...Object.keys(snapActive)])].map(k=>[k,mergeSameDayPatient(oldPatients[k],snapActive[k],now)])):snapActive,
      activeCount=Object.keys(activePatients).length,
      discharged=isSameDay?[]:Object.entries(oldPatients).filter(([k])=>!activePatients[k]).map(([k,p])=>({key:k,...p})),
      services=[...new Set([...(isSameDay?(previous?.meta?.services||[]):[]),...Object.values(snapshots).filter(Boolean).map(s=>s.service)].filter(Boolean))],
      submissionPatients=Object.fromEntries(patients.map(p=>{const rp=patientForFirebase(p);return[rp.key,rp]})),
      submissionKeys=Object.keys(submissionPatients),addedCount=submissionKeys.filter(k=>!oldPatients[k]).length,updatedCount=submissionKeys.length-addedCount;

    await fbPut(base+'/active',{meta:{schemaVersion:3,status:'ACTIVE',censusDate:state.censusDate,lastDeliveredAt:now,lastDeliveredBy:responsible,lastSubmissionId:submissionId,lastDeliveryType:deliveryType,patientCount:activeCount,serviceCount:services.length,services,version:VERSION},patients:activePatients});
    await fbPut(`${base}/submissions/${submissionId}`,{id:submissionId,status:'VALIDATED',deliveryType,updateOfDate:isSameDay?state.censusDate:'',censusDate:state.censusDate,deliveredAt:now,deliveredBy:responsible,deviceId:deviceId(),files:state.files.map(f=>({name:f.name,size:f.size,service:f.service,patientCount:f.count})),services:[...new Set(state.files.map(f=>f.service))],patientCount:patients.length,addedPatientCount:addedCount,updatedPatientCount:updatedCount,activeHospitalCount:activeCount,dischargedCount:discharged.length,patients:submissionPatients});

    if(discharged.length)await fbPut(`${base}/discharges/${Date.now()}`,{at:now,censusDate:state.censusDate,submissionId,detectedBy:responsible,count:discharged.length,patients:Object.fromEntries(discharged.map(p=>[p.key,{...p,internado:false,censusStatus:'ALTA_CENSO',dischargedAt:now}]))});

    const updates=[];
    for(const p of Object.values(activePatients)){
      const patch={nombre:p.nombre,internado:true,censusStatus:'INTERNADO',censusLastSeenAt:now,censusDate:state.censusDate,censusSubmissionId:submissionId,censusSource:'CENSO_HOSPITALARIO',updatedAt:now};
      if(p.expediente)patch.expediente=p.expediente;if(p.edad!==''&&p.edad!=null)patch.edad=p.edad;if(p.sexo){patch.sexo=p.sexo;patch.genero=p.sexo}if(p.diagnostico)patch.diagnostico=p.diagnostico;if(p.numeroCama)patch.numeroCama=p.numeroCama;if(p.ultimoServicio){patch.ultimoServicio=p.ultimoServicio;patch.servicio=p.ultimoServicio}updates.push(fbPatch(`/patient_catalog/${safePath(br)}/${safePath(p.key)}`,patch))
    }
    for(const p of discharged)updates.push(fbPatch(`/patient_catalog/${safePath(br)}/${safePath(p.key)}`,{internado:false,censusStatus:'ALTA_CENSO',censusDischargedAt:now,censusLastSeenAt:p.lastSeenAt||'',updatedAt:now}));
    for(let i=0;i<updates.length;i+=25)await Promise.allSettled(updates.slice(i,i+25));

    const orderRecon=await reconcileJustifiedOrders(activePatients,now,submissionId).catch(()=>({checked:0,inCensus:0,outCensus:0,filled:0}));
    await fbPatch(`${base}/submissions/${submissionId}`,{justifiedOrdersChecked:orderRecon.checked,justifiedOrdersInCensus:orderRecon.inCensus,justifiedOrdersOutCensus:orderRecon.outCensus,justifiedOrdersAutoFilled:orderRecon.filled}).catch(()=>{});
    await Promise.allSettled([
      fbPut(`/sync_versions/${safePath(br)}/census`,{v:Date.now(),updatedAt:now,source:'CENSO_HOSPITALARIO',deliveryType,censusDate:state.censusDate}),
      fbPut(`/sync_versions/${safePath(br)}/patients`,{v:Date.now()+1,updatedAt:now,source:'CENSO_HOSPITALARIO'}),
      fbPut(`/hospital_census_audit/${safePath(br)}/${safePath(submissionId)}`,{event:isSameDay?'CENSO_ACTUALIZADO':'CENSO_VALIDADO',deliveryType,at:now,by:responsible,censusDate:state.censusDate,patientCount:patients.length,addedPatientCount:addedCount,updatedPatientCount:updatedCount,activeHospitalCount:activeCount,dischargedCount:discharged.length,services:[...new Set(state.files.map(f=>f.service))],deviceId:deviceId()})
    ]);
    state.lastDeliveryId=submissionId;state.lastDeliveredAt=now;save();clearValidatedLocalDraft();await refreshRemote();activateTab('trazabilidad');
    toast(isSameDay?`Censo actualizado · ${addedCount} paciente(s) nuevo(s) · ${activeCount} pacientes activos`:`Censo diario validado · ${activeCount} pacientes internados · ${discharged.length} egreso(s)`)
  }catch(e){console.error(e);alert('No se pudo entregar el censo:\n\n'+(e?.message||e))}
  finally{if(btn)btn.textContent='Validar';if(btnVisible)btnVisible.textContent='✓ Validar y entregar';renderDeliveryState()}
}
async function refreshRemote(){
  try{
    await bindEcosystem();
    const base=`/hospital_census/${safePath(branch())}`,[active,subs,dis]=await Promise.all([fbGet(base+'/active').catch(()=>null),fbGet(base+'/submissions').catch(()=>null),fbGet(base+'/discharges').catch(()=>null)]),meta=active?.meta||{},rows=Object.values(subs||{}).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>String(b.deliveredAt||'').localeCompare(String(a.deliveredAt||''))).slice(0,12),dcount=Object.values(dis||{}).reduce((n,x)=>n+Number(x?.count||0),0);
    remoteState={activeCount:Number(meta.patientCount||Object.keys(active?.patients||{}).length),serviceCount:Number(meta.serviceCount||0),lastDeliveredAt:meta.lastDeliveredAt||'',lastDeliveredBy:meta.lastDeliveredBy||'',discharges:dcount};
    $('#remotePatients').textContent=remoteState.activeCount;$('#remoteServices').textContent=remoteState.serviceCount;$('#remoteLast').textContent=remoteState.lastDeliveredAt?new Date(remoteState.lastDeliveredAt).toLocaleString('es-MX',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'Sin entrega';$('#remoteDischarges').textContent=dcount;
    $('#remoteNotice').className='notice';$('#remoteNotice').innerHTML=meta.lastDeliveredAt?`Último censo ${meta.lastDeliveryType==='ACTUALIZACION_DIA'?'actualizado':'validado'} por <b>${esc(meta.lastDeliveredBy||'—')}</b> · ${esc(meta.censusDate||'')} · ${remoteState.activeCount} pacientes activos.`:'Aún no existe un censo hospitalario validado en Firebase.';
    $('#historyList').innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(r=>{const upd=r.deliveryType==='ACTUALIZACION_DIA',badge=upd?'ACTUALIZACIÓN':'CENSO DIARIO',detail=upd?`${r.patientCount||0} pacientes en esta actualización · ${r.addedPatientCount||0} nuevos · ${r.updatedPatientCount||0} actualizados · ${r.activeHospitalCount||0} activos hospital`:`${r.patientCount||0} pacientes en entrega · ${r.activeHospitalCount||0} activos hospital · ${r.dischargedCount||0} egresos detectados`;return `<div class="history-item"><div class="hrow"><div><b>${esc(r.deliveredBy||'Responsable')}</b><small>${esc(r.censusDate||'')} · ${(r.services||[]).map(esc).join(', ')}</small></div><span class="preview-badge remote">${badge}</span></div><small>${detail} · ${new Date(r.deliveredAt||Date.now()).toLocaleString('es-MX',{timeZone:'America/Mexico_City',hour12:false})}</small></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="muted">Sin entregas registradas.</div>';
    renderStats();setConnection(true,'Conectado · '+(getCfg().unitName||branch()));return true
  }catch(e){$('#remoteNotice').className='notice bad';$('#remoteNotice').textContent='No se pudo consultar trazabilidad: '+(e?.message||e);setConnection(false,'Sin conexión al ecosistema');return false}
}

<!-- MX V169: presentación corta de claves en visores; conserva la clave completa en el DOM y procesos -->
<style id="mx-clave-corta-global-v169">
.mx-clave-vista-v169{font-size:0!important;white-space:nowrap;display:inline!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.mx-clave-vista-v169::after{content:attr(data-mx-clave-corta);font-size:var(--mx-clave-font-size,12px)!important;font-weight:var(--mx-clave-font-weight,inherit)!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:inherit!important;letter-spacing:normal!important;color:currentColor!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
</style>
<script id="mx-clave-corta-global-script-v169">
(()=>{
  'use strict';
  const FULL_KEY_RE=/\b\d{3}\.\d{3}\.(\d{4})\.(\d{2})\b/g;
  const SKIP='script,style,noscript,textarea,template,[data-mx-clave-completa]';
  const shortText=(value)=>{FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;return String(value??'').replace(FULL_KEY_RE,(_,g4,g2)=>g4+'.'+g2);};
  const hasFullKey=(value)=>{FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;return FULL_KEY_RE.test(String(value??''));};
  window.mxClaveVista=shortText;
  window.mxClaveCorta=shortText;

  function markOption(opt){
    if(!opt)return;
    const raw=opt.textContent||'';
    const visual=shortText(raw);
    if(visual!==raw){
      opt.setAttribute('label',visual);
      opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169='1';
      if(!opt.title)opt.title=raw.trim();
    }else if(opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169==='1'){
      opt.removeAttribute('label');
      delete opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169;
    }
  }

  function makeKeySpan(full,short,parent){
    const span=document.createElement('span');
    span.className='mx-clave-vista-v169';
    span.dataset.mxClaveCorta=short;
    span.dataset.mxClaveCompleta=full;
    span.title=full;
    span.textContent=full;
    try{
      const cs=getComputedStyle(parent);
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-size',cs.fontSize||'12px');
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-weight',cs.fontWeight||'400');
    }catch(_){
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-size','12px');
    }
    return span;
  }

  function processText(node){
    if(!node||node.nodeType!==Node.TEXT_NODE)return;
    const parent=node.parentElement;
    if(!parent||parent.closest(SKIP)||parent.closest('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return;
    if(parent.namespaceURI&&parent.namespaceURI!=='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml')return;
    if(parent.tagName==='OPTION'){markOption(parent);return;}
    const raw=node.nodeValue||'';
    if(!hasFullKey(raw))return;
    FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;
    const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
    let last=0,m;
    while((m=FULL_KEY_RE.exec(raw))){
      if(m.index>last)frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(raw.slice(last,m.index)));
      frag.appendChild(makeKeySpan(m[0],m[1]+'.'+m[2],parent));
      last=m.index+m[0].length;
    }
    if(last<raw.length)frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(raw.slice(last)));
    node.replaceWith(frag);
  }

  function scan(root){
    if(!root)return;
    if(root.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE){processText(root);return;}
    if(root.nodeType!==Node.ELEMENT_NODE&&root.nodeType!==Node.DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE&&root.nodeType!==Node.DOCUMENT_NODE)return;
    if(root.nodeType===Node.ELEMENT_NODE){
      if(root.matches?.(SKIP)||root.closest?.('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return;
      if(root.tagName==='OPTION'){markOption(root);return;}
    }
    const walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode(n){
      const p=n.parentElement;
      if(!p||p.closest(SKIP)||p.closest('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
      return hasFullKey(n.nodeValue||'')?NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT:NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
    }});
    const pending=[];let n;
    while((n=walker.nextNode()))pending.push(n);
    pending.forEach(processText);
    if(root.querySelectorAll)root.querySelectorAll('option').forEach(markOption);
  }

  function start(){
    scan(document.body||document.documentElement);
    const mo=new MutationObserver(list=>{
      for(const rec of list){
        if(rec.type==='characterData'){processText(rec.target);continue;}
        for(const n of rec.addedNodes)scan(n);
      }
    });
    mo.observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true});
    window.__mxClaveCortaObserverV169=mo;
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start,{once:true});else start();
})();
</script>
